title: ericoides dumosum
intro: Ericoides dumosum, commonly known as Winter Jasmine, is a flowering vine native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Winter Jasmine include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of Winter Jasmine include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
